items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: I'll play with T-boy and him. I'll come here. 1922. 23. At 24.

ctx.x: I knew him, yeah. I knew him. He was funny. He's a man who used to drink his whiskey, uh, drink his water first, and then he'd drink his whiskey to get that awful taste out of his mouth. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Well, we had fun, man. Yeah. We and Albert Glennie and T-boy.

items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: That's T-Boy. Yeah. T-Boy, that's who I thought you were talking about.

ctx.x: That's T-Boy. Yeah. T-Boy, that's who I thought you were talking about. Yeah. T-Boy Gilmore.
Because he and Dad were great buddies. Yeah, little short dad.
I had Rayman T-boy Rayman. You ever meet him?
